name: Everything Comes to Dust
oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Exile all creatures except those that share a creature type with a creature that convoked this spell, all artifacts, and all enchantments.
blocked_sentences: Exile all creatures except those that share a creature type with a creature that convoked this spell, all artifacts, and all enchantments.

needs.what: a negated selector key matching objects that share NO creature type with any object in a sub-selector (here {"convoked": true}), where a convoking creature counts as sharing a type with itself, so a mass exile can spare creatures sharing a type with a creature that convoked the spell while still exiling every artifact and enchantment (an artifact creature sharing a type is still exiled)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Convoke itself is pay_generic_with: tap_creatures, and {"convoked": true} plus shares_a_creature_type_with (selector form) can name the SPARED set, but the selector language has no negation of it: there is not_types/not_subtypes but no not_shares_a_creature_type_with or general 'not' sub-selector, exclude_binding only removes the convoked creatures themselves (not those sharing a type with them) and no op binds an automatic set with 'as' to exclude. The selector form of shares_a_creature_type_with also drops the checked object from the comparison pool, so a convoked creature with a unique type would not count as sharing with itself
